prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one isolated Stone Age game building sprite. Attached image 1 (hut) and image 2 (camp scene) are locked style anchors: closely match their fine controlled dark ink contours, sparse interior linework, restrained natural earth-tone wash, two-tone upper-left illumination. Orthographic vertically overhead camera with only a slight front-face cheat, no isometric perspective. Uniform solid pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop everywhere outside the object, including holes. No extraneous surrounding ground apron, cast shadow, text, labels, people, photo, 3D rendering, pixel art, gradients, modern objects, or metal. Center with margin, crisp edges. South is bottom of image. A 2x2-tile lean-to shelter made of timber poles and bark, one SINGLE continuous sloping rectangular shed roof, high at north and low at south, open work side facing south. Clearly a shed/lean-to with one roof plane, NEVER a tent or A-frame. No detached props or floor slab.
